direction: Original dark-fantasy anime art with sharp ink, angular cel shadows, cinematic lighting and illustrated settings.
portraitFormat: 448 × 448 WebP expression frames cropped from six-panel master sheets.
spriteFormat: Transparent 3072 × 768 WebP motion atlases with 96 × 128 frames. South, east and north have original action drawings. West mirrors east.

secondArtBatch.artDirection: Crisp tapered ink, angular cel shadows, cinematic colored rim light, and fully illustrated fantasy settings.
